coordinateSpace: Source pixel coordinates inside the untrimmed AtlasLayout idle cell, bottom origin. Feet mark soles; body height excludes halos and wings. WeaponHand: 0=right, 1=left. WeaponWidth is full capsule width; optional tip radii enclose localized ornaments. Head radii enclose the face and hair around the head center. LegHemY marks highest visible leg/boot pixels; cloth above stays on the pelvis. StrideScale limits the complete gait displacement for each costume. Optional sourceMinX/sourceMaxX clip disconnected neighboring artwork horizontally while preserving the full connected character with transparent safety margins. All anchors retain original cell coordinates. Optional shoulder/elbow anchors are measured independently for both arms. Optional outline arrays use top-origin idle-cell pixel coordinates and take precedence at painted occlusions. Ankle anchors mark separate measured ankle centers; Foot anchors remain sole contacts.
